edit.description: readWorktreeRegistry: `worktree list --porcelain -z`, split on NUL, drop the `.trim()`
registry cases for a newline-bearing and a trailing-space worktree path

summary: Read git's worktree registry NUL-separated, so the set carries the path git named
acceptance: readWorktreeRegistry returns exactly the paths git names for worktree paths carrying a newline or trailing whitespace; pnpm test green
tests: the worktree registry carries a newline-bearing path as the one path git named
the worktree registry keeps a worktree path's trailing whitespace
notes: Measured on git 2.43: `worktree list --porcelain` never C-quotes, so the mangle is line-splitting plus `.trim()`, not quoting. git's own man page recommends `-z` with `--porcelain` here. `-z` for `worktree list` is git >=2.36; the repo declares no git floor — if that needs one, say so in the commit body rather than adding a fallback.
